fusions.name: Batted About
fusions.desc: A quick weapon strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and 20% slower for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Cornered Mouse
fusions.desc: Pounces on a target at or below 25% health for 26 damage, using up every affliction on it to add 1.2 times the damage they had left, and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Toying Feint
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 3 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Playing With It
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
